issues.header: P2 Left sidebar accordions trigger unexpected chat navigation instead of expanding
issues.details: The items in the left sidebar (e.g., '> Week of May 4', '> April 2026') have chevron icons indicating they are collapsible accordions. However, clicking them does not expand the section to show more items. Instead, it unexpectedly navigates the user to the 'Chat' view and populates the composer with a prompt related to a different time period (e.g., clicking 'Week of May 4' creates a prompt for 'April 2026'). This violates the visual affordance of the component and disrupts user navigation.

issues.header: P2 Accordion section fails to expand

issues.header: P3 Inconsistent button styling in header
issues.details: The 'Share' and 'Export preview' actions in the top right header appear as plain text without any button styling (background, border), making them look inconsistent next to the solid 'Save report' and 'Refresh preview' buttons. They also lack clear hover/active visual states.
